public.title: Array Concat
public.description: Return values followed by items. Each item that is an array contributes its direct elements; all other items contribute themselves. Flatten exactly one level of items, preserving deeper arrays. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.
hints: Spread each direct item array once, preserving arrays inside it.
Check the public examples against the documented empty-input and boundary rules.

explanation: Copy the receiver, then append direct elements of array items or the scalar item itself. O(n) time and output space for n contributed entries. This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
